description: This Java class defines a Fragment called LogFragment, which contains a custom LogView for displaying log data within an Android application. The fragment manages the creation, configuration, and display of the LogView inside a ScrollView, and updates the scroll position when new log data is added.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a log view for outputting log data, with automatic scrolling to the latest entries.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView for displaying logs.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Handles the fragment's view creation and sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on new log entries.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Provides access to the LogView instance contained in the fragment.
